_note: Two-minute drills. Each line is a made-up bad example the learner rewrites until the spots clear. tests/drills.test.ts checks every line has a spot in its set's C.

sets.title: Say it shorter
sets.blurb: Rewrite one wordy line until the spots clear.
lines: I just wanted to really say thanks for all of your help.
Due to the fact that the office is closed, we will basically meet at my desk.
At this point in time, I am actually still waiting for the form.
In order to get the refund, you simply need to send the receipt.
The report is really quite long and it is literally 40 pages.
In the event that you are late, please call the front desk.
We very much appreciate the fact that you came in on your day off.
I would just like to basically go over the plan one more time.
We are actually pretty much done with the first part of the job.
For the purpose of saving time, I will honestly keep this short.

sets.title: Say exactly when
sets.blurb: Swap fuzzy words for a real date, time, or number.
lines: Please send it ASAP.
I'll get back to you soon.
We need a lot of chairs for the event.
The meeting is sometime next week.
Some of the numbers are off.
Can you finish it by EOD?
Several people complained about the thing.
It will be ready in a while.
I'll call you later about the stuff.
The new prices start in the near future.

sets.title: Sound polite
sets.blurb: Turn a bossy or unsure line into a kind, clear one.
lines: You need to send this now.
PLEASE READ THE WHOLE FORM BEFORE YOU CALL.
You obviously didn't read my email.
I demand a refund immediately.
I think the form might be late, does that make sense?
Sorry to bother you, but I guess I need the file.
This is unacceptable and it must stop!!!
You should have told me this before.
I expect an answer from you today, no excuses.
Hopefully this is right, but I could be wrong.
